verdict.rationale: Call transfer is a fair question for a telephony voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents transferring a live call to a human, warm or blind transfer modes, or passing context during a handoff. The tools tab mentions ready-to-use tools only generically, without naming transfer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can escalate a live call to a human with warm or blind transfer, passing context along
